subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: Should OpenClaw repair corrupted Dashboard key mappings automatically, and what evidence must be required before relinking a key to a preserved transcript or trajectory file?
rationale: Source inspection proves current code would trust a bad stored mapping, but choosing a recovery rule without a fixture or durable identity signal could corrupt user history by relinking to the wrong file.

options.title: Diagnostic-first repair
options.body: Add a doctor diagnostic that reports candidate mismatches and only applies a fix when transcript/header/trajectory evidence uniquely identifies the correct target.

options.title: Wait for a redacted fixture
options.body: Keep the issue open until a sanitized store plus transcript/trajectory fixture proves the upgrade corruption path and expected repair behavior.

options.title: Defer to transcript identity work
options.body: Treat this as blocked on a broader durable transcript identity contract such as storing session keys in headers before attempting automatic repair.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic-first repair
recommendation.body: Add a doctor diagnostic that reports candidate mismatches and only applies a fix when transcript/header/trajectory evidence uniquely identifies the correct target.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent transcript reader and session identity refactors are the closest current ownership trail for a safe repair design.
